# Frozen P14 preparation controls

Declared before the first observation. These are test IDs, not initiative tasks.
All evidence below is synthetic preparation or a source invariant, NOT a native
scenario, installed-consumer success, independent verdict or release clearance.

| ID | Positive oracle | Negative / preservation oracle |
|---|---|---|
| C01 | Frozen executable bytes match the declared current source revision; historical base provenance remains separate | Changed frozen/current selected bytes are rejected; no historical-helper substitution or automatic repin |
| C02 | Every process/root is explicitly synthetic; Windows fixture Git uses command-scoped longpaths without persisted configuration | Escaping home/state/pointer, ambient selectors, credentials or fixture Git options on source commands refuse |
| C03 | One base request/seed/oracle and T001-T003 for all variants; current original authority is preserved before/after reads; legitimate A24.1 checkbox progress passes real P05/P08 consumers | No Universal A-ID enters the inventory task map; substantive requirement drift and withdrawn approval fail; current status is not forced incomplete |
| C04 | Actual P07 bootstrap, field/provenance reads and policy source consumption | Required missing pack, conflict and same-mtime manifest drift refuse without neutral clearance |
| C05 | Unchanged P07 reference verifies in a fresh process | Missing pin is not recreated on recovery; changed policy-source bytes invalidate P05 acceptance |
| C06 | P08 map/package/leaf readers retain P1 and T001-T003 | Unknown/parent leaf and changed acceptance are rejected, not renamed |
| C07 | Actual P03 owned read/snapshot/bind/restore preserves unrelated bytes | Out-of-root read and late-edit restore refuse; no root removal |
| C08 | P05 v2 context binds original work, profile, immutable typed obligations | Zero, skipped, failed and unknown controls block; type/policy downgrade cannot replace accepted obligations |
| C09 | Current actual tool names remain declared bindings, no claimed execution | Missing/denied delegation and absent independent review never become acceptance |
| C10 | P08 cycle helpers recover a mechanically paused PLAN from real stored identities | Wrong map/pin refuses; this is not native cold-session success |
| C11 | Strict-only TQ request validates against P09 with the same exact context | Missing obligation / absent result is unfinished; no decisions, corroboration or domain results are manufactured |
| C12 | Business oracle checks hand-calculated finite vectors and exact boundary cases | Unimplemented seed and wrong aggregate fail; nonzero exits and logs are retained |
| C13 | Toy atomic primitive demonstrates the accepted local equivalent, independently of inventory correctness | Direct-write and injected replacement failure discriminate; toy is not a solution or native output |

## Business cases frozen before implementation

Seed (six unique events; BOLT 5, NUT -2, WASHER 0); reversed order; identical
repeat; conflicting ID; malformed JSON; duplicate object key; extra/missing
field; bool/fractional/out-of-range delta; invalid ID/SKU; blank/empty input;
1,000-line inclusive bound; 1,001-line refusal; missing input; same-path alias.
All invalid batches preserve an existing sentinel output and input bytes.

## Later native sequence (proposal, not a dispatch)

1. Coordinator reviews this preparation SPEC then quality and releases exact
   source/fixture hashes, permissions, target roots and actors.
2. One neutral implementer context works from a clean identical seed; then one
   rapid-development context; then one strict-change context. The sequence is
   fixed before observations; record order effects, not a randomized causal trial.
   Do not expose other profiles' outputs. Keep only one target writer active.
3. Pause strict-change after actual T001/PLAN and before T002/BUILD. Save the
   real work/profile/cycle/evidence handoff. End that context. A genuinely fresh
   context reads only the frozen sources and durable handoff, verifies the same
   target/profile reference, and identifies the next original leaf before edits.
4. A distinct reviewer, created only under the later release, inspects each
   exact result and runs SPEC before quality. Rework returns to the appropriate
   implementer; it cannot be fixed by that reviewer or hidden by a changed oracle.
5. Use actual host read/edit/shell/delegation APIs, not a new scheduler. Regenerate
   P05 contexts with actual native actor/attempt IDs; preparation contexts cannot
   be reused as native ones. No P08/P09 actor or verdict is borrowed.

## Observations and unknowns

Use actual tool/actor event IDs for interventions and rework, monotonic command
timing plus timestamped actor start/pause/resume/end events for elapsed time, and
host-exported usage only if available with a stated scope. Missing usage, pricing,
model/version or actor timing stays unknown. Do not treat helper input-byte
estimates as measured tokens, or compute ROI from a single task.

Compare accepted R1-R6 plus applicable SC1-SC3, decisions and required controls.
An identical valid design/package is acceptable. Do not score file count, prompt
length, populated fields or narrative volume. Neutral/rapid have no SC1-SC3 gate.

## Released preparation correction

Coordinator release `2c4fc3d` preserves the historical experiment and adds the
paired progress/requirement/approval controls above. Any copied Universal map/
plan/spec/prompt is explicitly read-only-source test data in an owned synthetic
case, not a second initiative. The existing P05 Markdown boundary/progress
semantics and P08 reader remain authoritative; no second parser is introduced.
The harness does not change original task checkboxes in its source checkout.

The ordinary shell entry retains its original root dimensions and executable
selection. Windows-only `core.longpaths=true` uses Git's command environment
scope only for inspected fixture targets, including unchanged provider children.
No persistent/local/global Git setting, hook bypass, shortened target, other
Git installation or P10 investigation is authorized. Old E01/R01 and failed
run locks remain historical evidence, not silently repinned observations.
